speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned experiencing a new-onset movement disorder alongside your psychiatric condition; can you describe exactly what the movements look like, when they started, and if they happen only when you are asleep?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-Induced Hyperkinetic Movement Disorder (likely Tardive Dyskinesia or Akathisia) secondary to Risperidone use.

Given your significant improvement on risperidone, I need to determine if these movements are involuntary or a feeling of restlessness. Can you describe the specific quality of the movements and whether you feel an inner urge to keep moving?
